development_log.note: Documented that PepPCDB AF3 input generation is derived from our companion afrun project at https://github.com/zhaisilong/afrun, and clarified that precomputed MSA-enriched JSON prediction remains under internal testing.
Added a Browse detail tab and local CLI script for generating AF3 JSON inputs from PepPCDB peptide-protein annotations.

development_log.update: Home navigation and local 3D display were refined
development_log.note: Added Home CTA links for Browse, Status, About, and GitHub; integrated the PepPCDB banner and local Mol* structure rendering.

development_log.update: PepPCDB display was optimized and the deployment project was updated on GitHub
development_log.note: Refined Home layout, download naming, and function/affinity downloads; pushed the current deployment code to GitHub and deployed it on the server.

development_log.update: Manually curated structure-affinity data for peptide-protein complexes were integrated into PepPCDB
development_log.note: Added curated affinity records to support activity-aware peptide-protein complex annotation.

development_log.update: Agent-assisted audit was applied to existing function annotations
development_log.note: Reviewed existing annotations for consistency and quality.

development_log.update: Agent-assisted function annotation was added to the human-in-the-loop workflow
development_log.note: Introduced agent-generated function suggestions for curator review.
The Target-Pep function annotation schema was updated.

development_log.update: Browser-based function annotation tool was deployed
development_log.note: A web-based interface for human-in-the-loop function annotation became available.
Detailed legends and feature notes were moved into a standalone documentation page.

development_log.update: Annotation and interface rendering were upgraded
development_log.note: Cyclic, non-standard, connected, and non-polymer views were added, along with sequence-embedded interface markers.
A prebuilt SQLite backend was introduced, with baseline search, browse, and download functions made available online.
PepPCDB was derived from the Protein Data Bank.
